project_type: React 18.3 SPA with TypeScript - Educational LMS platform (Arabic RTL)
build_system: Vite 5.4 with @vitejs/plugin-react, manual chunks for react/query/charts
test_framework: No test framework installed - validation is via TypeScript type-check (tsc -b --noEmit) and Vite build
build_command: npm run build (runs tsc -b && vite build in frontend/)
test_command: npm run typecheck (runs tsc -b --noEmit in frontend/)
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npx tsc -b --noEmit` in frontend/ to confirm no type errors. 2. Run `npx vite build` in frontend/ to confirm production build succeeds.
setup_instructions: Project has all node_modules pre-installed. No additional setup needed.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install new npm packages. Must use only existing dependencies: React 18, Zustand 5, lucide-react, react-router-dom 6, @tanstack/react-query 5, chart.js, react-chartjs-2, react-hook-form, zod, axios, pdfjs-dist. CSS animations only (no framer-motion/GSAP). Custom i18n only (no react-intl/i18next). Keep as Vite SPA (no SSR).
contribution_requirements: Preserve all existing functionality, routing, and RTL support. Maintain current design direction and tokens system. Use existing CSS custom properties and design tokens.
key_patterns: Zustand stores in src/stores/ with persist middleware. Pages in src/pages/{role}/. Layout via AppShell with Sidebar+Topbar+BottomNav. Primitives in src/components/primitives/ (Card, Badge, MetricCard, ProgressBar, Tabs, Pill). States.tsx has Skeleton components already. GlobalSearch.tsx has debounced search with keyboard nav. CSS uses BEM-like class naming with data-attributes for variants. tokens.css has all design tokens, interactions.css has micro-interactions.
directory_structure: frontend/src/: App.tsx (router), main.tsx (entry+CSS imports), components/ (layout/ + primitives/ + Icon.tsx), pages/ (student/ teacher/ admin/ quality/ owner/ vision/), hooks/ (useAuth, useResources, useOwner, useReveal), stores/ (auth, theme, ui), styles/ (22 CSS files), lib/ (api, nav, numbers, queryClient, vision), utils/
